description: Focused expert review queue: 46 character/sign identities (27 core letters, 8 lonsum/consonants, 8 Cheitap/vowels, 3 other signs) plus combination and pronunciation tasks. Video and BOSEM chapter review records have been removed. Teaching names, pronunciation, writing order and linguistic examples remain for expert confirmation.

unicode.title: Unicode 18.0.0 Meetei Mayek Names List
unicode.scope: Official character identities and names only; not language teaching pronunciations.

items.writingNotes: For each combination, record the ordered component characters and any demonstrated writing sequence from a cited teaching source.
items.syllableExamples: List only combinations confirmed as valid or explicitly taught by a reliable source. Include the exact Meitei Mayek string, ordered component sequence, source-provided Roman form if any, and exact page or reference.
items.variantNotes: Record accepted alternatives and unresolved cases. Do not mark mechanically generated character+vowel-sign pairs as linguistically valid without evidence.
items.sourceReference: Expert to cite the relevant textbook page or other linguistic teaching source during review.
items.expertNotes: Unicode permits many technically encodable sequences, but that does not make them valid syllables or words. Do not treat every possible letter-plus-vowel-sign pair as an approved teaching combination. Record uncertainty and cite the source.

items.writingNotes: Record a clear natural sample only after confirming the intended linguistic identity and pronunciation. Describe the speaking context or variant if relevant.
items.syllableExamples: Where a character or combination has context-dependent pronunciations, record separate samples and explain each context.
items.variantNotes: Record dialectal or speaker variants when supported. Do not force a single pronunciation where evidence indicates variation.
items.sourceReference: Expert to cite the relevant textbook, published reference or native-speaker/linguist source during review.
items.expertNotes: Record pronunciation decisions with the source or speaker context. Audio recordings remain attached to this item in the Workbench. Use the separate audio review status to mark accepted or needs a new recording.
